pick.title: Select your CrossPoint
pick.description: These CrossPoint e-readers answered on the local network. Choose one, or enter the address manually.

device.title: CrossPoint e-reader
device.description: The e-reader web server runs only while the reader is in File Transfer (or Calibre Wireless) mode. It has no authentication: use it only on a trusted private network.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname, for example crosspoint.local.
data_description.model: Determines the screen resolution used for wallpapers.

library.title: Library folder
library.description: Books and wallpapers enter the library only through this folder, for example by copying them over Samba.

data_description.library_path: Absolute path on the Home Assistant host, for example /media/crosspoint.

error.cannot_connect_confirm: The e-reader is not reachable right now. Check the address, or submit again to save it anyway (the reader may simply not be in File Transfer mode).
error.path_not_allowed: Home Assistant is not allowed to access this folder. Use a folder under /media or add it to allowlist_external_dirs.

data_description.device_books_dir: Folder on the e-reader SD card where books are sent, for example /Books.

device_offline.message: The CrossPoint e-reader at {host} is not reachable. Put it in File Transfer mode and try again.

file_not_found.message: The book {file} is not in the library.

file_exists_on_device.message: A file named {file} already exists on the device and was not sent by Home Assistant. Send it again with overwrite enabled to replace it.

not_tracked.message: The book {file} was not sent by Home Assistant, so it cannot be removed from here.

not_on_device.message: The file {file} is no longer on the device. Remove it again with "forget missing" enabled to stop tracking it.

connection_lost.message: The connection to the e-reader was lost: {error}

entry_not_loaded.message: The CrossPoint configuration {title} is not loaded.

send_book.name: Send book
send_book.description: Uploads a book from the library to the e-reader. The e-reader must be in File Transfer mode.

config_entry_id.name: E-reader
config_entry_id.description: The CrossPoint e-reader to send the book to.

file.name: File
file.description: Path of the book, relative to the books subfolder of the library.

overwrite.name: Overwrite
overwrite.description: Replace a file with the same name on the device, even if it was not sent by Home Assistant.

remove_book.name: Remove book
remove_book.description: Deletes a book sent by Home Assistant from the e-reader. The e-reader must be in File Transfer mode.

config_entry_id.name: E-reader
config_entry_id.description: The CrossPoint e-reader to remove the book from.

file.name: File
file.description: Path of the book, relative to the books subfolder of the library.

forget_missing.name: Forget missing
forget_missing.description: Stop tracking the book if it is no longer on the device.

rescan_library.name: Rescan library
rescan_library.description: Scans the library folder now for new, changed or removed books and wallpapers.

config_entry_id.name: E-reader
config_entry_id.description: The CrossPoint e-reader whose library to scan.
